svg.title: baileys-cc-bridge
svg.desc: A WhatsApp group planning a trip. Ben says they still need a place to stay, you ask where to find a villa, and Mochi Bot, an AI agent with its own number, answers with three options and a PDF it made, signed Assisted by Claude. Rina thanks it. Next to the chat, the agent as a robot at its computer, reading the chat on its phone.
svg.text: we still need a place to stay 😅
hmm, any good villa in Ubud for 4?
woah the 2nd one 😍 thanks Mochi Bot!
